283	
284	                _plan_missing_descendants(child_rel_path, exp_node)
285	
286	        # Check for extraneous folders (in actual Drive but NOT matched)
287	        for act_folder in actual_subfolders:
288	            if act_folder["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
289	                act_id = act_folder["id"]
290	                act_name = act_folder["name"]
291	                child_rel_path = f"{current_path}/{act_name}".replace("//", "/")
292	                folders_count, files_count = drive_ops.get_folder_child_count(act_id)
293	
294	                if folders_count == 0 and files_count == 0:
295	                    # Empty extraneous folder: Safe to delete
296	                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
297	                        action_type="PRUNE_EMPTY",
298	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
299	                        folder_name=act_name,
300	                        current_name=act_name,
301	                        target_id=act_id,
302	                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
303	                        subfolders_count=0,
304	                        files_count=0,
305	                        reason="Extraneous folder not in template; completely empty",
306	                    ))
307	                else:
308	                    # Populated extraneous folder: MARK RED ANOMALY!
309	                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
310	                        action_type="FLAG_RED",
311	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
312	                        folder_name=act_name,
313	                        current_name=act_name,
314	                        target_id=act_id,
315	                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
316	                        subfolders_count=folders_count,
317	                        files_count=files_count,
318	                        current_desc=act_folder.get("description", ""),
319	                        reason=f"Extraneous folder contains {files_count} file(s) and {folders_count} subfolder(s). Must be preserved!",
320	                    ))
321	
322	    _evaluate_level(target_root_id, "/", template_schema.get("subfolders", {}))
323	    return plan
324	
325	
326	# =====================================================================
327	# RECONCILIATION EXECUTION ENGINE
328	# =====================================================================
329	
330	def execute_reconciliation(
331	    plan: ReconciliationPlan,
332	    dry_run: bool = False,
333	    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
334	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
335	    """
336	    Executes the reconciliation plan against Google Drive API:
337	    - Creates missing folders.
338	    - Updates mismatched descriptions.
339	    - Moves extraneous empty folders to Trash.
340	    - Skips populated anomalies (guaranteed zero data loss).
341	    - Logs audit run in SQLite.
342	    """
343	    summary = plan.summary()
344	    created_count = 0
345	    renamed_count = 0
346	    updated_desc_count = 0
347	    pruned_empty_count = 0
348	    flagged_red_count = summary["flagged_red_count"]
349	
350	    if dry_run:
351	        if log_callback:
352	            log_callback(f"[DRY RUN] Plan evaluated: {summary}")
353	        db.log_reconciliation_run(
354	            target_folder_id=plan.target_root_id,
355	            target_folder_name=plan.target_root_name,
356	            template_name=plan.template_name,
357	            created_count=summary["create_count"],
358	            updated_desc_count=summary["update_desc_count"],
359	            pruned_empty_count=summary["prune_empty_count"],
360	            flagged_red_count=flagged_red_count,
361	            dry_run=True,
362	            details={"actions": [item.__dict__ for item in plan.items]},
363	        )
364	        return {
365	            "dry_run": True,
366	            "summary": summary,
367	            "executed": False,
368	        }
369	
370	    # 0. Execute Renames
371	    for item in plan.renames:
372	        if item.target_id:
373	            if log_callback:
374	                log_callback(f"[Renaming Folder] '{item.current_name}' -> '{item.folder_name}' (ID: {item.target_id})")
375	            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
376	                file_id=item.target_id,
377	                name=item.folder_name,
378	                description=item.expected_desc if item.expected_desc else None,
379	                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
380	            )
381	            renamed_count += 1
382	
383	    # 1. Update mismatched descriptions
384	    for item in plan.description_mismatches:
385	        if item.target_id:
386	            if log_callback:
387	                log_callback(f"[Updating Description] {item.relative_path} -> '{item.expected_desc}'")
388	            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
389	                file_id=item.target_id,
390	                description=item.expected_desc,
391	                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
392	            )
393	            updated_desc_count += 1
394	
395	    # 2. Prune extraneous empty folders
396	    # Sort descending by path length to delete nested empty folders before empty parents
397	    for item in sorted(plan.extraneous_empty, key=lambda x: len(x.relative_path), reverse=True):
398	        if item.target_id:
399	            # Re-verify emptiness before trashing to ensure race-free safety
400	            if drive_ops.is_folder_empty(item.target_id):
401	                if log_callback:
402	                    log_callback(f"[Pruning Empty Folder] Moving {item.relative_path} (ID: {item.target_id}) to Trash")
403	                drive_ops.trash_file(item.target_id)
404	                pruned_empty_count += 1
405	            else:
406	                if log_callback:
407	                    log_callback(f"[Safety Warning] Folder {item.relative_path} gained items before pruning. Aborted deletion!")
408	
409	    # 3. Create missing folders (Path-aware map)
410	    # Map relative paths to their newly created Google Drive IDs
411	    path_to_id_map: Dict[str, str] = {"/": plan.target_root_id}
412	
413	    # Pre-populate map with existing matched folders
414	    for item in plan.compliant_folders + plan.description_mismatches + plan.renames:
415	        if item.target_id:
416	            path_to_id_map[item.relative_path] = item.target_id
417	
418	    # Sort missing folders ascending by path depth so parents are created before children
419	    missing_sorted = sorted(plan.missing_folders, key=lambda x: x.relative_path.count("/"))
420	
421	    for item in missing_sorted:
422	        parts = item.relative_path.strip("/").split("/")
423	        parent_rel_path = "/" + "/".join(parts[:-1]) if len(parts) > 1 else "/"
424	        parent_id = path_to_id_map.get(parent_rel_path, item.target_parent_id or plan.target_root_id)
425	
426	        if log_callback:
427	            log_callback(f"[Creating Folder] {item.relative_path} under parent {parent_id}")
428	
429	        created = drive_ops.create_folder(
430	            name=item.folder_name,
431	            parent_id=parent_id,
432	            description=item.expected_desc,
433	            properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
434	        )
435	        new_id = created["id"]
436	        path_to_id_map[item.relative_path] = new_id
437	        created_count += 1
438	
439	    # 4. Warn about populated anomalies
440	    for item in plan.extraneous_populated:
441	        if log_callback:
442	            log_callback(
443	                f"[⚠️ MARKED RED - POPULATED ANOMALY] {item.relative_path} "
444	                f"contains {item.files_count} file(s) and {item.subfolders_count} subfolder(s). PRESERVED UNTOUCHED."
445	            )
446	
447	    # 5. Log reconciliation run in SQLite
448	    db.log_reconciliation_run(
449	        target_folder_id=plan.target_root_id,
450	        target_folder_name=plan.target_root_name,
451	        template_name=plan.template_name,
452	        created_count=created_count,
453	        updated_desc_count=updated_desc_count,
454	        pruned_empty_count=pruned_empty_count,
455	        flagged_red_count=flagged_red_count,
456	        dry_run=False,
457	        details={"summary": summary},
458	    )
459	
460	    return {
461	        "dry_run": False,
462	        "created_count": created_count,
463	        "updated_desc_count": updated_desc_count,
464	        "pruned_empty_count": pruned_empty_count,
465	        "flagged_red_count": flagged_red_count,
466	        "summary": summary,
467	        "executed": True,
468	    }

621	def plan_entity_level_reconciliation(
622	    data_root_id: str,
623	    template_schema: Dict[str, Any],
624	    template_name: str = "Entity Archetype Template",
625	    bypass_cache: bool = False,
626	    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
627	) -> MultiEntityReconciliationPlan:
628	    """
629	    High-Performance Multi-Entity Reconciler with SQLite Cache Tier.
630	    Executes in 3 phased parallel waves:
631	    1. Phase 1: Level 1 Group Listing (Testament XX)
632	    2. Phase 2: Concurrent Entity Discovery across all groups (ThreadPoolExecutor)
633	    3. Phase 3: Concurrent Entity Subfolder Evaluation (ThreadPoolExecutor)
634	    Total network round-trips: exactly 3 concurrent phases instead of hundreds of sequential calls!
635	    """
636	    cache_key = f"{data_root_id}:{template_name}"
637	    if not bypass_cache:
638	        cached = db.get_cached_folder_tree(cache_key)
639	        if cached:
640	            cached_data, synced_at = cached
641	            if log_callback:
642	                log_callback(f"[SQLite Cache Recall] Loaded plan from cache (Synced at {synced_at})")
643	            return MultiEntityReconciliationPlan.from_dict(cached_data)
644	
645	    root_meta = drive_ops.get_file_metadata(data_root_id)
646	    root_name = root_meta.get("name", "Data Root")
647	
648	    multi_plan = MultiEntityReconciliationPlan(
649	        data_root_id=data_root_id,
650	        data_root_name=root_name,
651	        template_name=template_name,
652	        template_schema=template_schema,
653	    )
654	
655	    if log_callback:
656	        log_callback(f"[Phase 1: Querying Groups] {root_name} (ID: {data_root_id})")
657	
658	    # Phase 1: List all Level 1 groups (Testament <number>)
659	    group_folders = drive_ops.list_subfolders(data_root_id)
660	    group_folders.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("name", ""))
661	    group_ids = [g["id"] for g in group_folders]
662	
663	    if log_callback:
664	        log_callback(f"[Phase 2: Concurrent Entity Discovery] Querying {len(group_ids)} groups in parallel...")
665	
666	    # Phase 2: Parallel fetch of entities across all groups
667	    group_entities_map = drive_ops.parallel_list_subfolders(group_ids, max_workers=10)
668	
669	    # Collect all entities
670	    all_entity_ids = []
671	    for g_id in group_ids:
672	        ent_list = group_entities_map.get(g_id, [])
673	        all_entity_ids.extend([e["id"] for e in ent_list])
674	
675	    if log_callback:
676	        log_callback(f"[Phase 3: Multi-Depth BFS Tree Discovery] Scanning entity folder trees in parallel waves...")
677	
678	    # Phase 3+: Full Multi-Depth BFS Tree Discovery across all entities
679	    # Discovers all descendant folders down to arbitrary depth using parallel worker pools
680	    all_children_by_parent: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
681	    current_frontier = list(all_entity_ids)
682	    depth_wave = 1
683	
684	    while current_frontier:
685	        if log_callback:
686	            log_callback(f"[BFS Wave {depth_wave}] Fetching children for {len(current_frontier)} folder nodes in parallel...")
687	
688	        wave_results = drive_ops.parallel_list_subfolders(current_frontier, max_workers=15)
689	        next_frontier = []
690	        for parent_id, children in wave_results.items():
691	            all_children_by_parent[parent_id] = children
692	            for child in children:
693	                next_frontier.append(child["id"])
694	
695	        current_frontier = next_frontier
696	        depth_wave += 1
697	        if depth_wave > 10:  # Safety safeguard against circular parent structures
698	            break

700	    # Recursive Tree Diffing Engine for Subtrees of Arbitrary Depth
701	    def _compare_subtree(
702	        curr_target_id: str,
703	        curr_rel_path: str,
704	        expected_subfolders: Dict[str, Any],
705	        entity_plan: ReconciliationPlan,
706	    ):
707	        actual_children = all_children_by_parent.get(curr_target_id, [])
708	        actual_by_src: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
709	        actual_by_name: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
710	        for f in actual_children:
711	            actual_by_name[f["name"]] = f
712	            src = logic.extract_source_id(f)
713	            if src:
714	                actual_by_src[src] = f
715	
716	        matched_actual_ids = set()
717	
718	        # 1. Compare all expected archetype folders at this tree depth
719	        for exp_name, exp_node in expected_subfolders.items():
720	            exp_id = exp_node.get("id")
721	            child_rel_path = f"{curr_rel_path}/{exp_name}"
722	            exp_desc = (exp_node.get("description", "") or "").strip()
723	            expected_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(exp_id, exp_desc) if exp_id else exp_desc
724	            nested_expected = exp_node.get("subfolders", {})
725	
726	            # Match by immutable source ID first, name second
727	            act_child = None
728	            if exp_id and exp_id in actual_by_src:
729	                act_child = actual_by_src[exp_id]
730	            elif exp_name in actual_by_name and actual_by_name[exp_name]["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
731	                act_child = actual_by_name[exp_name]
732	
733	            if act_child:
734	                act_id = act_child["id"]
735	                matched_actual_ids.add(act_id)
736	                act_name = act_child["name"]
737	                act_desc = (act_child.get("description", "") or "").strip()
738	                act_src_id = logic.extract_source_id(act_child)
739	
740	                if act_name != exp_name:
741	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
742	                        action_type="RENAME",
743	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
744	                        folder_name=exp_name,
745	                        current_name=act_name,
746	                        target_id=act_id,
747	                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
748	                        current_desc=act_desc,
749	                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
750	                        source_id=exp_id,
751	                        reason=f"Renamed in template from '{act_name}' to '{exp_name}'",
752	                    ))
753	                elif (exp_desc and exp_desc not in act_desc) or (exp_id and act_src_id != exp_id):
754	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
755	                        action_type="UPDATE_DESC",
756	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
757	                        folder_name=exp_name,

761	                        current_desc=act_desc,
762	                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
763	                        source_id=exp_id,
764	                        reason="Subfolder description mismatch or missing source metadata",
765	                    ))
766	                else:
767	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
768	                        action_type="MATCH",
769	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
770	                        folder_name=exp_name,
771	                        current_name=act_name,
772	                        target_id=act_id,
773	                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
774	                        current_desc=act_desc,
775	                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
776	                        source_id=exp_id,
777	                        reason="Subfolder compliant with archetype",
778	                    ))
779	
780	                # RECURSIVELY COMPARE NEXT SUBTREE LEVEL
781	                _compare_subtree(
782	                    curr_target_id=act_id,
783	                    curr_rel_path=child_rel_path,
784	                    expected_subfolders=nested_expected,
785	                    entity_plan=entity_plan,
786	                )
787	            else:
788	                # Folder is missing at this branch
789	                entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
790	                    action_type="CREATE",
791	                    relative_path=child_rel_path,
792	                    folder_name=exp_name,
793	                    target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
794	                    expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
795	                    source_id=exp_id,
796	                    reason="Missing required archetype folder",
797	                ))
798	
799	                # Recursively plan creation of deeper missing descendants
800	                def _plan_missing_descendants(parent_path: str, node: Dict[str, Any]):
801	                    for c_name, c_node in node.get("subfolders", {}).items():
802	                        c_id = c_node.get("id")
803	                        c_desc = (c_node.get("description", "") or "").strip()
804	                        c_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(c_id, c_desc) if c_id else c_desc
805	                        c_path = f"{parent_path}/{c_name}"
806	                        entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
807	                            action_type="CREATE",
808	                            relative_path=c_path,
809	                            folder_name=c_name,
810	                            target_parent_id=None,
811	                            expected_desc=c_src_desc,
812	                            source_id=c_id,
813	                            reason="Nested folder inside missing archetype branch",
814	                        ))
815	                        _plan_missing_descendants(c_path, c_node)
816	
817	                _plan_missing_descendants(child_rel_path, exp_node)
818	
819	        # 2. Check for extraneous folders not present in template archetype
820	        for act_child in actual_children:
821	            if act_child["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
822	                act_id = act_child["id"]
823	                act_name = act_child["name"]
824	                child_rel_path = f"{curr_rel_path}/{act_name}"
825	
826	                # Check if this folder has any files or subfolders
827	                folders_count, files_count = drive_ops.get_folder_child_count(act_id)
828	                nested_children = all_children_by_parent.get(act_id, [])
829	                total_folders = max(folders_count, len(nested_children))
830	
831	                if total_folders == 0 and files_count == 0:
832	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
833	                        action_type="PRUNE_EMPTY",
834	                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
835	                        folder_name=act_name,
836	                        target_id=act_id,

839	                        files_count=0,

842	                else:

847	                        target_id=act_id,
848	                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
849	                        files_count=files_count,

851	                        current_desc=act_child.get("description", ""),
852	                        reason=f"Extraneous folder contains {files_count} file(s) and {total_folders} subfolder(s). PRESERVED UNTOUCHED.",
853	                    ))
854	
855	    # Assemble plans in memory (0ms RAM evaluation)
856	    for g in group_folders:
857	        g_id = g["id"]
858	        g_name = g.get("name", "Untitled Group")
859	        group_plan = EntityGroupPlan(group_name=g_name, group_id=g_id)

865	        else:
866	            for ent in entities:

870	                entity_plan = ReconciliationPlan(

876	                # Check root description of entity

878	                act_root_desc = (ent.get("description", "") or "").strip()
879	                if exp_root_desc and exp_root_desc != act_root_desc:
880	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
881	                        action_type="UPDATE_DESC",

885	                        current_desc=act_root_desc,

889	                else:
890	                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
891	                        action_type="MATCH",

895	                        current_desc=act_root_desc,
896	                        expected_desc=exp_root_desc,
897	                        reason="Entity root compliant",
898	                    ))
899	
900	                # Recursively compare full entity tree against template archetype tree
901	                _compare_subtree(
902	                    curr_target_id=ent_id,

904	                    expected_subfolders=template_schema.get("subfolders", {}),
905	                    entity_plan=entity_plan,
906	                )
907	
908	                group_plan.entity_plans.append(entity_plan)

910	        multi_plan.groups.append(group_plan)
911	
912	    # Save to SQLite cache for sub-second subsequent recalls
913	    try:

921	def execute_multi_entity_reconciliation(
922	    multi_plan: MultiEntityReconciliationPlan,
923	    dry_run: bool = False,
924	    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
925	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
926	    """
927	    Executes reconciliation using Google Native Multipart Batch Requests (50 ops / HTTP call).
928	    Combines creates, description updates, and safe pruning into high-throughput batch waves.
929	    """
930	    summary = multi_plan.summary()
931	
932	    if dry_run:
933	        if log_callback:
934	            log_callback(f"[DRY RUN COMPLETE] Multi-Entity Plan evaluated: {summary}")
935	        return {
936	            "dry_run": True,
937	            "summary": summary,
938	            "executed": False,
939	        }
940	
941	    # 0. Execute Renames
942	    renamed_count = 0
943	    for item in multi_plan.renames:
944	        if item.target_id:
945	            if log_callback:
946	                log_callback(f"[Renaming Folder] '{item.current_name}' -> '{item.folder_name}' (ID: {item.target_id})")
947	            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
948	                file_id=item.target_id,
949	                name=item.folder_name,
950	                description=item.expected_desc if item.expected_desc else None,
951	                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
952	            )
953	            renamed_count += 1
954

# core/reconciler.py
"""
Declarative Desired-State Reconciler for Arc-2-Neo-Drives.
Continuously reconciles Google Drive folder structures against an ideal template schema:
1. Missing Folders -> Provisioned with matching description.
2. Description Drift -> Updated to match template metadata.
3. Extraneous Empty Folders -> Safely pruned to Trash.
4. Extraneous Populated Folders -> PRESERVED, marked in RED anomaly alert.
"""

from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Callable, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from itertools import groupby
from . import drive_ops
from . import db
from . import logic


# =====================================================================
# SCHEMA EXTRACTION & NORMALIZATION
# =====================================================================

def extract_schema_from_drive_folder(folder_id: str, log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Recursively scans an existing Google Drive folder to construct the canonical ideal schema.
    Returns:
    {
        "id": "1qPYOlZ3...",
        "name": "Folder Name",
        "description": "Key: Value1, Value2",
        "subfolders": {
            "ChildA": { "id": "...", "name": "ChildA", "description": "...", "subfolders": {} }
        }
    }
    """
    meta = drive_ops.get_file_metadata(folder_id)
    folder_name = meta.get("name", "Untitled")
    folder_desc = meta.get("description", "") or ""

    if log_callback:
        log_callback(f"[Reading Template] Folder: {folder_name} (ID: {folder_id})")

    sub_items = drive_ops.list_subfolders(folder_id)
    subfolders_dict: Dict[str, Any] = {}

    for item in sub_items:
        child_id = item["id"]
        child_name = item["name"]
        subfolders_dict[child_name] = extract_schema_from_drive_folder(child_id, log_callback)

    return {
        "id": folder_id,
        "name": folder_name,
        "description": folder_desc,
        "subfolders": subfolders_dict,
    }


# =====================================================================
# PLAN DATA STRUCTURES
# =====================================================================

@dataclass
class ActionItem:
    action_type: str  # "CREATE", "RENAME", "UPDATE_DESC", "PRUNE_EMPTY", "FLAG_RED", "MATCH"
    relative_path: str
    folder_name: str
    target_id: Optional[str] = None
    target_parent_id: Optional[str] = None
    current_desc: str = ""
    expected_desc: str = ""
    current_name: Optional[str] = None
    subfolders_count: int = 0
    files_count: int = 0
    reason: str = ""
    source_id: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class ReconciliationPlan:
    target_root_id: str
    target_root_name: str
    template_name: str
    items: List[ActionItem] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def missing_folders(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "CREATE"]

    @property
    def renames(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "RENAME"]

    @property
    def description_mismatches(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "UPDATE_DESC"]

    @property
    def extraneous_empty(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "PRUNE_EMPTY"]

    @property
    def extraneous_populated(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "FLAG_RED"]

    @property
    def compliant_folders(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.items if i.action_type == "MATCH"]

    def summary(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        return {
            "create_count": len(self.missing_folders),
            "rename_count": len(self.renames),
            "update_desc_count": len(self.description_mismatches),
            "prune_empty_count": len(self.extraneous_empty),
            "flagged_red_count": len(self.extraneous_populated),
            "compliant_count": len(self.compliant_folders),
            "total_evaluated": len(self.items),
        }


# =====================================================================
# RECONCILIATION PLANNING ENGINE
# =====================================================================

def plan_reconciliation(
    target_root_id: str,
    template_schema: Dict[str, Any],
    template_name: str = "Custom Template",
    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
) -> ReconciliationPlan:
    """
    Compares the actual target directory tree against the template schema.
    Generates a deterministic plan with categorized actions.
    """
    target_meta = drive_ops.get_file_metadata(target_root_id)
    target_root_name = target_meta.get("name", "Target Root")
    plan = ReconciliationPlan(
        target_root_id=target_root_id,
        target_root_name=target_root_name,
        template_name=template_name,
    )

    # 1. Evaluate root description compliance
    expected_root_desc = (template_schema.get("description", "") or "").strip()
    actual_root_desc = (target_meta.get("description", "") or "").strip()

    if expected_root_desc and expected_root_desc != actual_root_desc:
        plan.items.append(ActionItem(
            action_type="UPDATE_DESC",
            relative_path="/",
            folder_name=target_root_name,
            target_id=target_root_id,
            current_desc=actual_root_desc,
            expected_desc=expected_root_desc,
            reason="Root folder description deviates from template schema",
        ))
    else:
        plan.items.append(ActionItem(
            action_type="MATCH",
            relative_path="/",
            folder_name=target_root_name,
            target_id=target_root_id,
            current_desc=actual_root_desc,
            expected_desc=expected_root_desc,
            reason="Root folder compliant",
        ))

    # 2. Recursively evaluate subfolders
    def _evaluate_level(curr_target_parent_id: str, current_path: str, expected_subfolders: Dict[str, Any]):
        # List actual subfolders currently present in Google Drive
        actual_subfolders = drive_ops.list_subfolders(curr_target_parent_id)

        # Build lookup indices for actual subfolders (immutable source ID first, name fallback)
        actual_by_src: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        actual_by_name: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for f in actual_subfolders:
            actual_by_name[f["name"]] = f
            src = logic.extract_source_id(f)
            if src:
                actual_by_src[src] = f

        matched_actual_ids = set()

        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[Evaluating] {current_path} ({len(actual_subfolders)} subfolders found)")

        # Check all expected folders from template
        for exp_name, exp_node in expected_subfolders.items():
            exp_id = exp_node.get("id")
            child_rel_path = f"{current_path}/{exp_name}".replace("//", "/")
            exp_desc = (exp_node.get("description", "") or "").strip()
            expected_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(exp_id, exp_desc) if exp_id else exp_desc
            exp_children = exp_node.get("subfolders", {})

            # 1. Match by immutable source ID (Rename-Proof)
            act_folder = None
            if exp_id and exp_id in actual_by_src:
                act_folder = actual_by_src[exp_id]
            # 2. Legacy fallback by Name
            elif exp_name in actual_by_name and actual_by_name[exp_name]["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
                act_folder = actual_by_name[exp_name]

            if act_folder:
                act_id = act_folder["id"]
                matched_actual_ids.add(act_id)
                act_name = act_folder["name"]
                act_desc = (act_folder.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                act_src_id = logic.extract_source_id(act_folder)

                # Check if folder was renamed in template
                if act_name != exp_name:
                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="RENAME",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason=f"Renamed in template from '{act_name}' to '{exp_name}'",
                    ))
                elif (exp_desc and exp_desc not in act_desc) or (exp_id and act_src_id != exp_id):
                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="UPDATE_DESC",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason="Description mismatch or missing source metadata",
                    ))
                else:
                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="MATCH",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason="Folder and metadata fully compliant",
                    ))

                # Recurse into this matching folder
                _evaluate_level(act_id, child_rel_path, exp_children)

            else:
                # Folder MISSING: Must be created
                plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                    action_type="CREATE",
                    relative_path=child_rel_path,
                    folder_name=exp_name,
                    target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                    expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                    source_id=exp_id,
                    reason="Required template folder does not yet exist",
                ))

                # Recursively plan creation of deeper nested subfolders
                def _plan_missing_descendants(parent_rel_path: str, missing_node: Dict[str, Any]):
                    for child_k, child_v in missing_node.get("subfolders", {}).items():
                        desc_rel_path = f"{parent_rel_path}/{child_k}".replace("//", "/")
                        c_id = child_v.get("id")
                        c_desc = (child_v.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                        c_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(c_id, c_desc) if c_id else c_desc
                        plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                            action_type="CREATE",
                            relative_path=desc_rel_path,
                            folder_name=child_k,
                            expected_desc=c_src_desc,
                            source_id=c_id,
                            reason="Nested folder inside missing parent",
                        ))
                        _plan_missing_descendants(desc_rel_path, child_v)

                _plan_missing_descendants(child_rel_path, exp_node)

        # Check for extraneous folders (in actual Drive but NOT matched)
        for act_folder in actual_subfolders:
            if act_folder["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
                act_id = act_folder["id"]
                act_name = act_folder["name"]
                child_rel_path = f"{current_path}/{act_name}".replace("//", "/")
                folders_count, files_count = drive_ops.get_folder_child_count(act_id)

                if folders_count == 0 and files_count == 0:
                    # Empty extraneous folder: Safe to delete
                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="PRUNE_EMPTY",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=act_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                        subfolders_count=0,
                        files_count=0,
                        reason="Extraneous folder not in template; completely empty",
                    ))
                else:
                    # Populated extraneous folder: MARK RED ANOMALY!
                    plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="FLAG_RED",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=act_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_parent_id,
                        subfolders_count=folders_count,
                        files_count=files_count,
                        current_desc=act_folder.get("description", ""),
                        reason=f"Extraneous folder contains {files_count} file(s) and {folders_count} subfolder(s). Must be preserved!",
                    ))

    _evaluate_level(target_root_id, "/", template_schema.get("subfolders", {}))
    return plan


# =====================================================================
# RECONCILIATION EXECUTION ENGINE
# =====================================================================

def execute_reconciliation(
    plan: ReconciliationPlan,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Executes the reconciliation plan against Google Drive API:
    - Creates missing folders.
    - Updates mismatched descriptions.
    - Moves extraneous empty folders to Trash.
    - Skips populated anomalies (guaranteed zero data loss).
    - Logs audit run in SQLite.
    """
    summary = plan.summary()
    created_count = 0
    renamed_count = 0
    updated_desc_count = 0
    pruned_empty_count = 0
    flagged_red_count = summary["flagged_red_count"]

    if dry_run:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[DRY RUN] Plan evaluated: {summary}")
        db.log_reconciliation_run(
            target_folder_id=plan.target_root_id,
            target_folder_name=plan.target_root_name,
            template_name=plan.template_name,
            created_count=summary["create_count"],
            updated_desc_count=summary["update_desc_count"],
            pruned_empty_count=summary["prune_empty_count"],
            flagged_red_count=flagged_red_count,
            dry_run=True,
            details={"actions": [item.__dict__ for item in plan.items]},
        )
        return {
            "dry_run": True,
            "summary": summary,
            "executed": False,
        }

    # 0. Execute Renames
    for item in plan.renames:
        if item.target_id:
            if log_callback:
                log_callback(f"[Renaming Folder] '{item.current_name}' -> '{item.folder_name}' (ID: {item.target_id})")
            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
                file_id=item.target_id,
                name=item.folder_name,
                description=item.expected_desc if item.expected_desc else None,
                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
            )
            renamed_count += 1

    # 1. Update mismatched descriptions
    for item in plan.description_mismatches:
        if item.target_id:
            if log_callback:
                log_callback(f"[Updating Description] {item.relative_path} -> '{item.expected_desc}'")
            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
                file_id=item.target_id,
                description=item.expected_desc,
                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
            )
            updated_desc_count += 1

    # 2. Prune extraneous empty folders
    # Sort descending by path length to delete nested empty folders before empty parents
    for item in sorted(plan.extraneous_empty, key=lambda x: len(x.relative_path), reverse=True):
        if item.target_id:
            # Re-verify emptiness before trashing to ensure race-free safety
            if drive_ops.is_folder_empty(item.target_id):
                if log_callback:
                    log_callback(f"[Pruning Empty Folder] Moving {item.relative_path} (ID: {item.target_id}) to Trash")
                drive_ops.trash_file(item.target_id)
                pruned_empty_count += 1
            else:
                if log_callback:
                    log_callback(f"[Safety Warning] Folder {item.relative_path} gained items before pruning. Aborted deletion!")

    # 3. Create missing folders (Path-aware map)
    # Map relative paths to their newly created Google Drive IDs
    path_to_id_map: Dict[str, str] = {"/": plan.target_root_id}

    # Pre-populate map with existing matched folders
    for item in plan.compliant_folders + plan.description_mismatches + plan.renames:
        if item.target_id:
            path_to_id_map[item.relative_path] = item.target_id

    # Sort missing folders ascending by path depth so parents are created before children
    missing_sorted = sorted(plan.missing_folders, key=lambda x: x.relative_path.count("/"))

    for item in missing_sorted:
        parts = item.relative_path.strip("/").split("/")
        parent_rel_path = "/" + "/".join(parts[:-1]) if len(parts) > 1 else "/"
        parent_id = path_to_id_map.get(parent_rel_path, item.target_parent_id or plan.target_root_id)

        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[Creating Folder] {item.relative_path} under parent {parent_id}")

        created = drive_ops.create_folder(
            name=item.folder_name,
            parent_id=parent_id,
            description=item.expected_desc,
            properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
        )
        new_id = created["id"]
        path_to_id_map[item.relative_path] = new_id
        created_count += 1

    # 4. Warn about populated anomalies
    for item in plan.extraneous_populated:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(
                f"[⚠️ MARKED RED - POPULATED ANOMALY] {item.relative_path} "
                f"contains {item.files_count} file(s) and {item.subfolders_count} subfolder(s). PRESERVED UNTOUCHED."
            )

    # 5. Log reconciliation run in SQLite
    db.log_reconciliation_run(
        target_folder_id=plan.target_root_id,
        target_folder_name=plan.target_root_name,
        template_name=plan.template_name,
        created_count=created_count,
        updated_desc_count=updated_desc_count,
        pruned_empty_count=pruned_empty_count,
        flagged_red_count=flagged_red_count,
        dry_run=False,
        details={"summary": summary},
    )

    return {
        "dry_run": False,
        "created_count": created_count,
        "updated_desc_count": updated_desc_count,
        "pruned_empty_count": pruned_empty_count,
        "flagged_red_count": flagged_red_count,
        "summary": summary,
        "executed": True,
    }


# =====================================================================
# OPTION A: MULTI-ENTITY (TESTAMENT -> ENTITY) RECONCILER
# =====================================================================

@dataclass
class EntityGroupPlan:
    group_name: str  # e.g. "Testament 03"
    group_id: str
    entity_plans: List[ReconciliationPlan] = field(default_factory=list)
    empty_note: str = ""


@dataclass
class MultiEntityReconciliationPlan:
    data_root_id: str
    data_root_name: str
    template_name: str
    template_schema: Dict[str, Any]
    groups: List[EntityGroupPlan] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def all_items(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        items = []
        for g in self.groups:
            for ep in g.entity_plans:
                items.extend(ep.items)
        return items

    @property
    def missing_folders(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "CREATE"]

    @property
    def renames(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "RENAME"]

    @property
    def description_mismatches(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "UPDATE_DESC"]

    @property
    def extraneous_empty(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "PRUNE_EMPTY"]

    @property
    def extraneous_populated(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "FLAG_RED"]

    @property
    def compliant_folders(self) -> List[ActionItem]:
        return [i for i in self.all_items if i.action_type == "MATCH"]

    def summary(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        return {
            "total_groups": len(self.groups),
            "total_entities": sum(len(g.entity_plans) for g in self.groups),
            "create_count": len(self.missing_folders),
            "rename_count": len(self.renames),
            "update_desc_count": len(self.description_mismatches),
            "prune_empty_count": len(self.extraneous_empty),
            "flagged_red_count": len(self.extraneous_populated),
            "compliant_count": len(self.compliant_folders),
            "total_evaluated": len(self.all_items),
        }

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "data_root_id": self.data_root_id,
            "data_root_name": self.data_root_name,
            "template_name": self.template_name,
            "template_schema": self.template_schema,
            "summary": self.summary(),
            "groups": [
                {
                    "group_name": g.group_name,
                    "group_id": g.group_id,
                    "empty_note": g.empty_note,
                    "entity_plans": [
                        {
                            "target_root_id": ep.target_root_id,
                            "target_root_name": ep.target_root_name,
                            "template_name": ep.template_name,
                            "summary": ep.summary(),
                            "items": [
                                {
                                    "action_type": item.action_type,
                                    "relative_path": item.relative_path,
                                    "folder_name": item.folder_name,
                                    "current_name": item.current_name,

                                    "target_parent_id": item.target_parent_id,

                                    "expected_desc": item.expected_desc,

                                    "files_count": item.files_count,
                                    "reason": item.reason,
                                    "source_id": item.source_id,
                                }
                                for item in ep.items
                            ],
                        }
                        for ep in g.entity_plans
                    ],
                }
                for g in self.groups

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "MultiEntityReconciliationPlan":
        multi_plan = cls(
            data_root_id=data.get("data_root_id", ""),
            data_root_name=data.get("data_root_name", ""),
            template_name=data.get("template_name", ""),
            template_schema=data.get("template_schema", {}),
        )
        for g_data in data.get("groups", []):
            group_plan = EntityGroupPlan(
                group_name=g_data.get("group_name", ""),
                group_id=g_data.get("group_id", ""),
                empty_note=g_data.get("empty_note", ""),
            )
            for ep_data in g_data.get("entity_plans", []):
                ep = ReconciliationPlan(
                    target_root_id=ep_data.get("target_root_id", ""),
                    target_root_name=ep_data.get("target_root_name", ""),
                    template_name=ep_data.get("template_name", ""),
                )
                for it_data in ep_data.get("items", []):
                    ep.items.append(
                        ActionItem(
                            action_type=it_data.get("action_type", "MATCH"),
                            relative_path=it_data.get("relative_path", ""),
                            folder_name=it_data.get("folder_name", ""),
                            current_name=it_data.get("current_name"),
                            target_id=it_data.get("target_id"),
                            target_parent_id=it_data.get("target_parent_id"),
                            current_desc=it_data.get("current_desc", ""),
                            expected_desc=it_data.get("expected_desc", ""),

                            files_count=it_data.get("files_count", 0),
                            reason=it_data.get("reason", ""),
                            source_id=it_data.get("source_id"),
                        )
                    )
                group_plan.entity_plans.append(ep)
            multi_plan.groups.append(group_plan)
        return multi_plan


def plan_entity_level_reconciliation(
    data_root_id: str,
    template_schema: Dict[str, Any],
    template_name: str = "Entity Archetype Template",
    bypass_cache: bool = False,
    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
) -> MultiEntityReconciliationPlan:
    """
    High-Performance Multi-Entity Reconciler with SQLite Cache Tier.
    Executes in 3 phased parallel waves:
    1. Phase 1: Level 1 Group Listing (Testament XX)
    2. Phase 2: Concurrent Entity Discovery across all groups (ThreadPoolExecutor)
    3. Phase 3: Concurrent Entity Subfolder Evaluation (ThreadPoolExecutor)
    Total network round-trips: exactly 3 concurrent phases instead of hundreds of sequential calls!
    """
    cache_key = f"{data_root_id}:{template_name}"
    if not bypass_cache:
        cached = db.get_cached_folder_tree(cache_key)
        if cached:
            cached_data, synced_at = cached
            if log_callback:
                log_callback(f"[SQLite Cache Recall] Loaded plan from cache (Synced at {synced_at})")
            return MultiEntityReconciliationPlan.from_dict(cached_data)

    root_meta = drive_ops.get_file_metadata(data_root_id)
    root_name = root_meta.get("name", "Data Root")

    multi_plan = MultiEntityReconciliationPlan(
        data_root_id=data_root_id,
        data_root_name=root_name,
        template_name=template_name,
        template_schema=template_schema,
    )

    if log_callback:
        log_callback(f"[Phase 1: Querying Groups] {root_name} (ID: {data_root_id})")

    # Phase 1: List all Level 1 groups (Testament <number>)
    group_folders = drive_ops.list_subfolders(data_root_id)
    group_folders.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("name", ""))
    group_ids = [g["id"] for g in group_folders]

    if log_callback:
        log_callback(f"[Phase 2: Concurrent Entity Discovery] Querying {len(group_ids)} groups in parallel...")

    # Phase 2: Parallel fetch of entities across all groups
    group_entities_map = drive_ops.parallel_list_subfolders(group_ids, max_workers=10)

    # Collect all entities
    all_entity_ids = []
    for g_id in group_ids:
        ent_list = group_entities_map.get(g_id, [])
        all_entity_ids.extend([e["id"] for e in ent_list])

    if log_callback:
        log_callback(f"[Phase 3: Multi-Depth BFS Tree Discovery] Scanning entity folder trees in parallel waves...")

    # Phase 3+: Full Multi-Depth BFS Tree Discovery across all entities
    # Discovers all descendant folders down to arbitrary depth using parallel worker pools
    all_children_by_parent: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    current_frontier = list(all_entity_ids)
    depth_wave = 1

    while current_frontier:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[BFS Wave {depth_wave}] Fetching children for {len(current_frontier)} folder nodes in parallel...")

        wave_results = drive_ops.parallel_list_subfolders(current_frontier, max_workers=15)
        next_frontier = []
        for parent_id, children in wave_results.items():
            all_children_by_parent[parent_id] = children
            for child in children:
                next_frontier.append(child["id"])

        current_frontier = next_frontier
        depth_wave += 1
        if depth_wave > 10:  # Safety safeguard against circular parent structures
            break

    # Recursive Tree Diffing Engine for Subtrees of Arbitrary Depth
    def _compare_subtree(
        curr_target_id: str,
        curr_rel_path: str,
        expected_subfolders: Dict[str, Any],
        entity_plan: ReconciliationPlan,
    ):
        actual_children = all_children_by_parent.get(curr_target_id, [])
        actual_by_src: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        actual_by_name: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for f in actual_children:
            actual_by_name[f["name"]] = f
            src = logic.extract_source_id(f)
            if src:
                actual_by_src[src] = f

        matched_actual_ids = set()

        # 1. Compare all expected archetype folders at this tree depth
        for exp_name, exp_node in expected_subfolders.items():
            exp_id = exp_node.get("id")
            child_rel_path = f"{curr_rel_path}/{exp_name}"
            exp_desc = (exp_node.get("description", "") or "").strip()
            expected_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(exp_id, exp_desc) if exp_id else exp_desc
            nested_expected = exp_node.get("subfolders", {})

            # Match by immutable source ID first, name second
            act_child = None
            if exp_id and exp_id in actual_by_src:
                act_child = actual_by_src[exp_id]
            elif exp_name in actual_by_name and actual_by_name[exp_name]["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
                act_child = actual_by_name[exp_name]

            if act_child:
                act_id = act_child["id"]
                matched_actual_ids.add(act_id)
                act_name = act_child["name"]
                act_desc = (act_child.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                act_src_id = logic.extract_source_id(act_child)

                if act_name != exp_name:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="RENAME",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason=f"Renamed in template from '{act_name}' to '{exp_name}'",
                    ))
                elif (exp_desc and exp_desc not in act_desc) or (exp_id and act_src_id != exp_id):
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="UPDATE_DESC",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason="Subfolder description mismatch or missing source metadata",
                    ))
                else:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="MATCH",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=exp_name,
                        current_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                        current_desc=act_desc,
                        expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                        source_id=exp_id,
                        reason="Subfolder compliant with archetype",
                    ))

                # RECURSIVELY COMPARE NEXT SUBTREE LEVEL
                _compare_subtree(
                    curr_target_id=act_id,
                    curr_rel_path=child_rel_path,
                    expected_subfolders=nested_expected,
                    entity_plan=entity_plan,
                )
            else:
                # Folder is missing at this branch
                entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                    action_type="CREATE",
                    relative_path=child_rel_path,
                    folder_name=exp_name,
                    target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                    expected_desc=expected_src_desc,
                    source_id=exp_id,
                    reason="Missing required archetype folder",
                ))

                # Recursively plan creation of deeper missing descendants
                def _plan_missing_descendants(parent_path: str, node: Dict[str, Any]):
                    for c_name, c_node in node.get("subfolders", {}).items():
                        c_id = c_node.get("id")
                        c_desc = (c_node.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                        c_src_desc = logic.format_source_description(c_id, c_desc) if c_id else c_desc
                        c_path = f"{parent_path}/{c_name}"
                        entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                            action_type="CREATE",
                            relative_path=c_path,
                            folder_name=c_name,
                            target_parent_id=None,
                            expected_desc=c_src_desc,
                            source_id=c_id,
                            reason="Nested folder inside missing archetype branch",
                        ))
                        _plan_missing_descendants(c_path, c_node)

                _plan_missing_descendants(child_rel_path, exp_node)

        # 2. Check for extraneous folders not present in template archetype
        for act_child in actual_children:
            if act_child["id"] not in matched_actual_ids:
                act_id = act_child["id"]
                act_name = act_child["name"]
                child_rel_path = f"{curr_rel_path}/{act_name}"

                # Check if this folder has any files or subfolders
                folders_count, files_count = drive_ops.get_folder_child_count(act_id)
                nested_children = all_children_by_parent.get(act_id, [])
                total_folders = max(folders_count, len(nested_children))

                if total_folders == 0 and files_count == 0:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="PRUNE_EMPTY",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                        subfolders_count=0,
                        files_count=0,
                        reason="Extraneous folder not in template; completely empty",
                    ))
                else:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="FLAG_RED",
                        relative_path=child_rel_path,
                        folder_name=act_name,
                        target_id=act_id,
                        target_parent_id=curr_target_id,
                        files_count=files_count,
                        subfolders_count=total_folders,
                        current_desc=act_child.get("description", ""),
                        reason=f"Extraneous folder contains {files_count} file(s) and {total_folders} subfolder(s). PRESERVED UNTOUCHED.",
                    ))

    # Assemble plans in memory (0ms RAM evaluation)
    for g in group_folders:
        g_id = g["id"]
        g_name = g.get("name", "Untitled Group")
        group_plan = EntityGroupPlan(group_name=g_name, group_id=g_id)
        entities = group_entities_map.get(g_id, [])
        entities.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("name", ""))

        if not entities:
            group_plan.empty_note = "Trống (Không có entity nào trong nhóm này)"
        else:
            for ent in entities:
                ent_id = ent["id"]
                ent_name = ent.get("name", "Untitled Entity")

                entity_plan = ReconciliationPlan(
                    target_root_id=ent_id,
                    target_root_name=ent_name,
                    template_name=f"{template_name} -> {ent_name}",
                )

                # Check root description of entity
                exp_root_desc = (template_schema.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                act_root_desc = (ent.get("description", "") or "").strip()
                if exp_root_desc and exp_root_desc != act_root_desc:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="UPDATE_DESC",
                        relative_path=f"{g_name}/{ent_name}",
                        folder_name=ent_name,
                        target_id=ent_id,
                        current_desc=act_root_desc,
                        expected_desc=exp_root_desc,
                        reason="Entity root description mismatch",
                    ))
                else:
                    entity_plan.items.append(ActionItem(
                        action_type="MATCH",
                        relative_path=f"{g_name}/{ent_name}",
                        folder_name=ent_name,
                        target_id=ent_id,
                        current_desc=act_root_desc,
                        expected_desc=exp_root_desc,
                        reason="Entity root compliant",
                    ))

                # Recursively compare full entity tree against template archetype tree
                _compare_subtree(
                    curr_target_id=ent_id,
                    curr_rel_path=f"{g_name}/{ent_name}",
                    expected_subfolders=template_schema.get("subfolders", {}),
                    entity_plan=entity_plan,
                )

                group_plan.entity_plans.append(entity_plan)

        multi_plan.groups.append(group_plan)

    # Save to SQLite cache for sub-second subsequent recalls
    try:
        db.cache_folder_tree(cache_key, multi_plan.to_dict())
    except Exception:
        pass

    return multi_plan


def execute_multi_entity_reconciliation(
    multi_plan: MultiEntityReconciliationPlan,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    log_callback: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Executes reconciliation using Google Native Multipart Batch Requests (50 ops / HTTP call).
    Combines creates, description updates, and safe pruning into high-throughput batch waves.
    """
    summary = multi_plan.summary()

    if dry_run:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[DRY RUN COMPLETE] Multi-Entity Plan evaluated: {summary}")
        return {
            "dry_run": True,
            "summary": summary,
            "executed": False,
        }

    # 0. Execute Renames
    renamed_count = 0
    for item in multi_plan.renames:
        if item.target_id:
            if log_callback:
                log_callback(f"[Renaming Folder] '{item.current_name}' -> '{item.folder_name}' (ID: {item.target_id})")
            drive_ops.update_folder_meta(
                file_id=item.target_id,
                name=item.folder_name,
                description=item.expected_desc if item.expected_desc else None,
                properties={"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
            )
            renamed_count += 1

    # 1. Batch Description Updates
    desc_specs = [
        {"file_id": item.target_id, "description": item.expected_desc}
        for item in multi_plan.description_mismatches
        if item.target_id
    ]
    if desc_specs:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[Batch HTTP] Updating {len(desc_specs)} descriptions in batch...")
        updated_count = drive_ops.batch_update_descriptions(desc_specs)
    else:
        updated_count = 0

    # 2. Batch Trashing Extraneous Empty Folders
    # Sort descending by relative path depth so deepest leaf empty folders are trashed first
    empty_sorted = sorted(multi_plan.extraneous_empty, key=lambda x: x.relative_path.count("/"), reverse=True)
    trash_ids = [
        item.target_id for item in empty_sorted
        if item.target_id and drive_ops.is_folder_empty(item.target_id)
    ]
    if trash_ids:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(f"[Batch HTTP] Trashing {len(trash_ids)} empty folders in batch...")
        pruned_count = drive_ops.batch_trash_files(trash_ids)
    else:
        pruned_count = 0

    # 3. Multi-Depth Folder Creations
    # Populate path-to-ID lookup map with existing entities, matched folders, and renames
    path_to_id: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for g in multi_plan.groups:
        path_to_id[g.group_name] = g.group_id
        for ep in g.entity_plans:
            path_to_id[f"{g.group_name}/{ep.target_root_name}"] = ep.target_root_id

    for item in multi_plan.compliant_folders + multi_plan.description_mismatches + multi_plan.renames + multi_plan.extraneous_populated:
        if item.target_id:
            path_to_id[item.relative_path] = item.target_id

    # Sort missing folders ascending by depth so parents are provisioned before nested children
    missing_sorted = sorted(multi_plan.missing_folders, key=lambda x: x.relative_path.count("/"))
    created_count = 0

    for depth, items_at_depth in groupby(missing_sorted, key=lambda x: x.relative_path.count("/")):
        batch_specs = []
        for item in items_at_depth:
            parts = item.relative_path.strip("/").split("/")
            parent_path = "/".join(parts[:-1])
            parent_id = path_to_id.get(parent_path, item.target_parent_id)

            if parent_id:
                batch_specs.append({
                    "name": item.folder_name,
                    "parent_id": parent_id,
                    "description": item.expected_desc,
                    "properties": {"src": item.source_id} if item.source_id else None,
                    "relative_path": item.relative_path,
                })

        if batch_specs:
            if log_callback:
                log_callback(f"[Batch HTTP Wave] Creating {len(batch_specs)} missing folders at tree depth {depth}...")
            created_results = drive_ops.batch_create_folders(batch_specs)
            for res in created_results:
                if res.get("relative_path") and res.get("id"):
                    path_to_id[res["relative_path"]] = res["id"]
            created_count += len(created_results)

    # 4. Warn about populated anomalies
    for item in multi_plan.extraneous_populated:
        if log_callback:
            log_callback(
                f"[🚨 BÁO ĐỎ - GIỮ NGUYÊN AN TOÀN] {item.relative_path} "
                f"chứa {item.files_count} file(s). KHÔNG XÓA."
            )

    return {
        "dry_run": False,
        "created_count": created_count,
        "renamed_count": renamed_count,
        "updated_desc_count": updated_count,
        "pruned_empty_count": pruned_count,
        "flagged_red_count": summary["flagged_red_count"],
        "summary": summary,
        "executed": True,
    }

# core/local_template.py
"""
Sovereign Local Template Engine for Drive Architect.
The template lives strictly and exclusively as physical directories on Local Disk D:
Path: templates/Entropy 0
Completely offline, fixed, and immutable from remote Google Drive.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional

TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "templates" / "Entropy 0"
TEMPLATES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def scan_physical_template_tree() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Scans the physical directory structure of templates/Entropy 0 on Local Disk D:
    Constructs the canonical archetype tree with recognized origin aliases.
    """
    # Known alias mappings for robust source tracking across historical seeds
    KNOWN_ALIASES = {
        "01_audio": ["tpl_audio", "tpl_01_audio", "01_audio"],
        "01_source_clips": ["tpl_video", "tpl_01_source_clips", "01_raw_footage", "01_source_clips"],
        "sub_cuts": ["tpl_video_cuts", "tpl_sub_cuts", "sub_cuts"],
        "03_docs": ["tpl_docs", "tpl_03_docs", "03_docs"],
        "04_vfx": ["tpl_vfx", "tpl_04_vfx", "04_vfx"],
        "05_lighting": ["tpl_lighting", "tpl_05_lighting", "05_lighting"],
        "avatar": ["tpl_avatar", "avatar"],
        "default": ["tpl_avatar_default", "default"],
    }

    def _scan_dir(current_dir: Path, rel_path: str = "", parent_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        nodes = []
        if not current_dir.exists():
            return nodes

        for item in sorted(current_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda x: (not x.is_dir(), x.name)):
            if item.is_dir():
                child_rel = f"{rel_path}/{item.name}".strip("/")
                clean_key = item.name.lower()
                slug_id = f"tpl_{clean_key}"
                aliases = KNOWN_ALIASES.get(clean_key, [slug_id, clean_key])

                nodes.append({
                    "id": slug_id,
                    "name": item.name,
                    "description": f"src:{slug_id}",
                    "parentId": parent_id or "tpl_entropy_0_local",
                    "rel_path": child_rel,
                    "aliases": aliases,
                    "children": _scan_dir(item, child_rel, slug_id),
                })
        return nodes

    children = _scan_dir(TEMPLATES_DIR, "", "tpl_entropy_0_local")

    return {
        "id": "tpl_entropy_0_local",
        "name": "Entropy 0 (Local Master)",
        "description": "Physical Local Template on Local Disk D:",
        "parentId": None,
        "children": children,
    }


def get_local_template_tree() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Alias for scan_physical_template_tree to satisfy API endpoints."""
    return scan_physical_template_tree()


def save_local_template_mutations(creates: List[Any], updates: List[Any], deletes: List[Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Returns the local template tree (fixed locally on Disk D)."""
    tree = scan_physical_template_tree()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "created_count": 0,
        "updated_count": 0,
        "deleted_count": 0,
        "tree": tree,
        "vault_tags": {},
        "master": "local_disk_d",
    }


def get_template_expected_subfolders() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Returns the expected subfolders dictionary formatted for the reconciler:
    { "01_Source_Clips": { "id": "tpl_01_source_clips", "name": "...", "aliases": [...], "subfolders": {...} } }
    """
    tree = scan_physical_template_tree()

    def _convert_to_subfolders_dict(children: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        result = {}
        for c in children:
            result[c["name"]] = {
                "id": c["id"],
                "name": c["name"],
                "description": c.get("description", ""),
                "aliases": c.get("aliases", []),
                "subfolders": _convert_to_subfolders_dict(c.get("children", [])),
            }
        return result

    return _convert_to_subfolders_dict(tree.get("children", []))
